reasons: CS3219 prerequisite is YSC3232 or CS2103 or CS2103T or CS2103DE or CS2113T or CS2113. The student has completed CS2030S and CS2040S, but none of the listed prerequisites for CS3219 are completed or available to be taken in Semester 3 (Y2S1) as they require CS2030/CS2040 variants which are completed, but the specific bridge courses (CS2103 etc) are missing. Specifically, CS2103 requires CS2030S/CS2030/CS2030DE/CS2030HS AND CS2040S/CS2040/CS2040C/CS2040HS/CS2040DE. The student has CS2030S and CS2040S. Thus CS2103 is eligible in Sem 3. However, CS3219 requires CS2103 (or others) to be completed. If CS2103 is taken in Sem 3, CS3219 cannot be taken in Sem 3. The student mandates CS3219 in Sem 3. This is impossible because CS2103 (a prerequisite for CS3219) cannot be completed before Sem 3 if it is first taken in Sem 3. CS2103 is not completed. Therefore CS3219 cannot be taken in Sem 3.
